stages.name: draft
stages.command: python3 transform_stub.py draft --main inputs/main.md --out output/draft.md --meta work/draft_meta.json --table inputs/missing_table.csv

stages.name: finalize
stages.command: python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output/result.json --field draft_path --value output/draft.md && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output/result.json --field word_count --value-json "$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('work/draft_meta.json'))['draft_chars'])")" && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output/result.json --field limitations --value-json "[\"inputs/missing_table.csv 缺失：性能对比数据未填入，相关结论待人工核实\", \"能量密度口径冲突：main.md 为 320 Wh/kg，task.md 为 350 Wh/kg，未经人工确认未写入草稿\", \"源文含未发表数据：仅本地处理，禁止外发\"]" && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py finalize --result output/result.json --outdir output --case case.json
